criterion: Fixed before the claim runs. Percentiles: mid-rank among the corpus pieces of the same type (both colours, v for the owner). Rank fraction f = (rank - 1) / reachable (0 = its square is the best, 1 = the worst); a piece with no safe alternative gets no placement verdict. placement+: gap pct >= 75 and f <= 0.25. placement-: gap pct <= 25 and f >= 0.5. general score: for a knight or bishop the mean of ceiling pct and (100 - swap pct) (a swap that loses value is a point for the piece; ceiling pct alone if the swap board is illegal), for a rook or queen ceiling pct. general+: score >= 75; general-: score <= 25. both: the placement and the general rule in the claim's direction. Bishop pairs: supported iff both bishops pass. Ambiguous: no verdict.
disagreement: Placement Shapley disagrees with the single-piece marginal when |phi - single| > 0.1, or the signs differ with both |values| > 0.05.
